sloka: यथा शरदि मेघानाम् सिञ्चातामपि गर्जताम् ।न भवत्यमुबसम्क्लेदस्तथानार्येषु सौहृदम् ॥६-१६-१२॥।।
transliteration: yathā śaradi meghānām siñcātāmapi garjatām ।na bhavatyamubasamkledastathānāryeṣu sauhṛdam ॥6-16-12॥।।

translations.english: "Just as honeybees do not have gratitude after drinking (honey) and satisfying, the friendship with an unworthy person like you is of no use."
